WITH step1 AS (
    SELECT 
        o.account_id,
        d.A3,
        AVG(o.amount) as avg_order_amount
    FROM "order" o 
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id 
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id 
    WHERE o.amount > 2802.0 
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
step2 AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_order_amount) as overall_avg
    FROM step1
)
SELECT 
    step1.account_id,
    step1.A3,
    step1.avg_order_amount,
    step1.avg_order_amount - step2.overall_avg as difference
FROM step1, step2
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
